title: Acceptance fixed-priority arbiter
behavior: Combinational four-request arbiter, lowest numbered asserted request wins. grant is one-hot or zero. valid equals any request. index identifies winning request, and is zero when valid is zero. No fairness or state.

requirements.text: Choose the lowest numbered asserted bit of request.
requirements.acceptance: Exhaust all 16 request vectors against an independently derived reference.

requirements.text: grant has exactly one requested bit when any request is asserted, otherwise zero.
requirements.acceptance: Check one-hot-or-zero, subset-of-request and priority for every vector.

requirements.text: valid is OR of request; index is the winning bit or zero when idle.
requirements.acceptance: Verify all outputs together for every vector and transitions between vectors.
